component.name: Portly
component.summary: See what's running on your ports — and free them in one click

description.p: Portly simplifies managing the ports on your Linux machine. It lists every listening TCP and UDP port, shows which process owns it, and lets you stop that process from a window or straight from the system tray.

ul.li: Live list of ports with process, PID, user and full command line
Search, filter by protocol and "Mine only", sort by port or process
Stop or force kill the process behind a port
Tray menu with your processes and the status of your favorite ports
Notifications when a favorite port opens or closes
